text.content:
Naturalists have dedicated themselves to understanding one creature Species, developing an uncanny ability to track it down and survive the encounter.

SKILLS

Avid Seeker · SL max 4

Choose a Species as your Forte when you take this Skill — never humanoid. Once per scene, create a Bond of admiration or inferiority toward a creature of your Forte Species whose presence or signs you are aware of: that creature becomes your Quarry until the Bond breaks or you choose anew. You gain +(SL) to Checks to track, locate, identify and Study your Quarry. If your Quarry is absent, you may use an action and spend 1 Fabula Point to learn its direction and perform a free remote Study of it. If no Bond can form, the Species is not present and did not pass through.

Field Kit · SL max 5

On first acquisition choose a track — Slaying, Research or Taming — and gain its basic tier. Each further level buys one: a new track's basic tier, the advanced tier of a track you have, or the superior tier of a track whose advanced tier you have.

SLAYING — Hunter's Infusions. On a successful hit, spend 2 IP to lace the attack (one infusion per attack). Basic and advanced infusions: +5 damage, +10 against your Forte, plus the rider. Choose two per tier bought (advanced picks may take basic options).

TierInfusionRider
BasicAnti-RegenTarget cannot heal until it has hit you
BasicAstralEqual damage to the entity possessing or controlling the target
BasicDefangTarget cannot inflict statuses until it has hit you
BasicHarpoonTarget cannot flee without spending an Ultima Point until it has hit you
BasicSeverErases a magical or psychic Bond — or the target spends an Ultima Point to keep it
BasicTracerTarget becomes your Quarry, even off-Forte
AdvancedSnare / Fetter / FlashInflict slow / weak / dazed
Superior (Forte only)Engineered (2 IP) · Engineered+ (3 IP)Inflict a chosen status, bypassing status immunity
Superior (Forte only)Adaptive (4 IP)The damage converts to the target's Vulnerability type

The two superior-tier infusions await a ruling. Engineered's status-immunity bypass is not covered by the blanket resistance-bypass conversion, and Adaptive is an auto-Vulnerability hit. Both are recorded as printed; ask your GM before relying on either.

RESEARCH. Basic: Tonics, Elixirs and Elemental Shards aimed at your Forte cost 1 less IP, and your Tonics clear all conditions a Forte creature caused; you always carry sampling tools. Advanced: the spectrographic camera — an Inventory-action "weapon," (DEX + INS) +2, two-handed arcane ranged, 0 light damage, 1 IP per shot; a hit produces a spectrograph revealing the creature's Resistances (not Vulnerabilities), its attack elements, and one non-obvious trait; once per day a Hunter, Tinkerer or Loremaster may Study a creature from its spectrograph as though it were present; if equipped at conflict start, spend 5 MP to shoot immediately after Initiative (locked out against High Speed and Prey Instinct). Superior: the travelling lab — minutes to erect anywhere not immediately hostile, a sterile workspace Tinkerers can invent in, and −10 MP off rituals (−20 if the ritual's effects stay inside the lab; doubles at level 40).

TAMING. Basic: an action + 1 IP for a spoken command to a soldier-rank Forte creature, Opposed (INS + WLP). The printed commands: recover from enraged · −4 to keep held items · skip the Objective action · attack a named non-ally · avoid a named creature this round. Custom commands: one sentence, one clause, one named creature, never self-harm, abandon-allies or leave-scene; obviously risky commands give the target +2. Advanced: Capture a Forte creature the party met and did not kill (the GM sets the price in zenit, IP or an Opposed Check) — it becomes a Companion with 3 Loyalty Points and one spell, maximum three Companions; an Inventory action + 1 Loyalty + the spell's MP summons it to cast and leave; at zero Loyalty it goes home for good. Superior (the Menagerie): Companions travel with you regardless of distance, and 4 IP at capture Seals a creature — freed only by ritual, or by a Villain spending an Ultima Point, which frees all of them at once.

Hardened Hunter · SL max 3

While no equipment fixes your Magic Defense to a flat value, you gain +(SL) Magic Defense — +(SL + 1) against creatures of your Forte.

Prepared Ground

The four Hunter Rituals only, in a discipline flavour of your choice: Arm Up (a community gains +5 damage against your Forte via a swapped weapon Quality); Freedom (release a controlled or possessed creature — fails if it takes damage during the performance); Smoke Out (Forte creatures in the area must reveal themselves; a Villain may spend an Ultima Point to stay hidden); Land Survey (know the ritual area like the back of your hand). Helpers' Inventory Points cut the Mind Point cost, 10 MP per point.

Target Insight · SL max 2

Identify your Forte's Species on sight, and see when any visible creature is possessed or controlled. The first time each scene you Study a Forte creature (not via Avid Seeker), ask up to (SL) questions about its condition, motives or emotions.
